visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and round glasses, wearing a vertical black-and-white striped shirt, sits on a beige sofa and speaks to the camera. The background consists of a cream-colored wall with white vertical panels. A clinic logo is visible in the top left corner. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a tablet screen displaying a blue-tinted digital analysis of a face, with bright pink spots indicating bacterial clusters on the skin. A hand points at the screen. (3) The video returns to the woman in the striped shirt, who continues speaking while gesturing with her hands to emphasize her points. (4) A young woman with her hair in a ponytail is shown in a modern bathroom with grey marble walls, washing her face at a white sink with flowing water. (5) The woman in the striped shirt reappears, touching her cheeks with her fingertips as she describes skin texture and cleaning procedures. (6) A close-up shot shows a hand touching a person's cheek and moving toward the eye area, highlighting the skin's surface texture and pores. (7) Back to the woman in the striped shirt as she concludes her talk, gesturing with her hands and maintaining eye contact with the lens. (8) An outro screen appears featuring a white minimalist design with the clinic logo, contact numbers, LINE ID, and two office addresses in Traditional Chinese.
